title: A kb/_self doc left stale by another change does not fail an unrelated item's done
goal: selfdoc.py stale in an item's checks reports only staleness the item's own commits cause, or sync refuses to push a change that leaves a doc stale, so an item's done is not blocked by another sprint's commit (TK-uxm5arrb needed an empty Self-Reviewed commit for AGENTS.md after 17d0f58 in SP-v5xagbyv)
